hooks.name: Acquia Cloud Hooks
hooks.description: Automate Drupal deployments with database updates, cache clearing, and environment-specific configurations on Acquia Cloud platform.

hooks.name: Terraform Cloud GitHub Action
hooks.description: Automate infrastructure validation and compliance checks on every pull request using Terraform Cloud integration.

hooks.name: GitHub Actions Webhook Proxy
hooks.description: Proxy webhooks from GitHub to internal services behind firewalls. Perfect for self-hosted runners and secure environments.

hooks.name: Kubernetes Admission Webhooks
hooks.description: Validate and mutate Kubernetes resources before they're persisted. Enforce policies and inject sidecar containers automatically.

hooks.name: Database Migration Hook
hooks.description: Automatically run database migrations on deployment. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB with rollback capabilities.

hooks.name: Slack Deployment Notifier
hooks.description: Send rich Slack notifications on deployment events. Includes success/failure status, deployment duration, and commit details.

hooks.name: Pre-commit Security Scan
hooks.description: Scan code for secrets, vulnerabilities, and security issues before commits. Integrates with popular secret detection tools.

hooks.name: Datadog CI Visibility
hooks.description: Track CI/CD pipeline performance and test results in Datadog. Identify bottlenecks and optimize build times.

hooks.name: Playwright Test Reporter Webhook
hooks.description: Send Playwright test results to custom endpoints. Generate detailed HTML reports and notify teams of test failures.

hooks.name: AWS Lambda Deploy Hook
hooks.description: Deploy AWS Lambda functions automatically on git push. Supports environment variables, layers, and blue-green deployments.

hooks.name: Jenkins Pipeline Webhook
hooks.description: Trigger Jenkins pipelines via webhooks with dynamic parameters. Supports GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket integrations.

hooks.name: Sentry Release Tracking
hooks.description: Automatically create Sentry releases on deployment. Track errors by release version and associate commits with issues.

hooks.name: Docker Build and Push Hook
hooks.description: Build Docker images and push to registries on code changes. Multi-platform builds with caching support.

hooks.name: E2E Test Automation Hook
hooks.description: Run end-to-end tests automatically on pull requests. Supports Cypress, Selenium, and Puppeteer frameworks.

hooks.name: Email Notification Hook
hooks.description: Send customizable email notifications on build events. HTML templates, attachments, and multiple recipient support.
